slug: 2026-06-15 Telecom Namibia signs more satellite, subsea connectivity deals with Angola firms

facts.fact: Telecom Namibia signed a pilot commercial agreement with Angola's GGPEN to use the Angosat-2 satellite platform in a real-network trial, moving on from a proof of concept, with a commercial launch to follow the pilot (reported 2026-06-15, signed the preceding Friday).

Telecom Namibia signed a master service agreement with Angola Telecom and SATCAB to integrate the Southern African Regional Submarine System (SARSSy) with the Equiano cable via Telecom Namibia's Swakopmund landing station, with Telecom Namibia as landing party and giving Angola Telecom 1 Tbps on Equiano; it builds on an MoU and commercial terms agreement signed in April 2026.

systems.tiers: Telecom Namibia (operator), targeting lodges, mines, schools, farms, businesses and rural communities

systems.platform: submarine cable interconnecting with Equiano at Swakopmund

systems.tiers: Telecom Namibia provides Angola Telecom 1 Tbps
